text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere at Симболи Рудольф's
long-awaited
debut is as charged as a
real graded race, but she
only sees the
pressure as an opportunity.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With her back straight and head
unbowed, she
makes her way to the
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
